E0307

`if`/multi-head dispatch not exhaustive (lists missing)

What

`if`/multi-head dispatch not exhaustive (lists missing)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Add the missing dispatch arms or provide an `else` arm.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0307: tests/ui/dispatch_not_exhaustive.stderr.
